body.statement: For every ordered pair \((K,O)\), vertex \(i\), and equal labeled outdegrees, \[\max_{L\in\mathcal L_i(K,O)}\{|\operatorname{ch}_K(i)\cap L|-|\operatorname{ch}_O(i)\cap L|\}=\max_{A\subseteq P_i(K,O)}\{|A|-|\operatorname{nb}_{\Gamma_i(K,O)}(A)|\}=\Delta_i(K,O).\] Hence a positive comparator-parent certificate exists exactly when \(\Gamma_i(K,O)\) lacks a perfect matching, and a maximizing \(L\) is recoverable in polynomial time by maximum matching and alternating reachability.
body.justification: This theorem turns an exponential closed-set search into the exact Hall object needed by the universal kernel.
body.gap: Drton, Hollering, and Wu enumerate parentally closed sets; Foygel, Draisma, and Drton give a flow paradigm for a different within-graph half-trek problem.
body.consumer: A failed matching returns the explicit set \(L\) used by the precision-rank certificate in Theorem 2.
